purpose: The external follow-up report of 2026-08-28, recorded VERBATIM as claimed numbers before this project measured any of them, and sealed. D-015: pre-registration is enforced by a hash, not by intent. The reviewer's report is a legitimate pre-registration for a reproduction -- it named every number in advance -- and freezing it here is what makes the agreement checkable rather than asserted.

source.note: The reviewer states the project tree was untouched and no source change, commit or push was made. HEAD is three commits ahead of this snapshot; both commits touching _TRAJECTORY_FILES add code that either raises or does nothing (MS-C-719 input check, MS-C-723 constraints) and neither writes to a state, so trajectories are unchanged by construction. tests/golden.json agrees on all ten cases.

decision_rule: Each claim below is compared against an independently derived measurement. A claim is CONFIRMED when the measurement matches, EXTENDED when the measurement covers a strictly wider scope and agrees on the reported slice, and CONTESTED otherwise. A CONTESTED claim is reported with both numbers and neither is silently preferred. The consequence of a CONTESTED claim is that it is recorded as contested in docs/OPEN_OBLIGATIONS.md and blocks any citation of the claim until resolved.

S1_lo_zero_periods.statement: The lo=0 revival mechanism strongly prefers discrete period 2, but period 2 is not universal; period 1, period 4, and runs with no exact period inside a finite horizon all occur within the same production scope.
S1_lo_zero_periods.reviewer_scope_note: These describe what a FUTURE re-run produces under the current make_initial_state. init.py states its procedure is not bit-equal to the original U0 production PRNG consumption, so the result must not be attributed retroactively to the bytes of the old artefact.

S2_single_edge_robustness.statement: Over all labelled graphs and all live U0 Boolean fixed points at n=2..6, the fixed points invariant under EVERY single-edge addition or deletion are exactly those with n=6, |A|=3, G[A]=K3, all A-P edges present, and G[P] a matching (empty matching included).
S2_single_edge_robustness.reviewer_scope_note: Stated as a complete finite-domain result that may replace the mu_v > 1/(d_v+1) margin proposal; explicitly NOT yet asserted as an n>6 theorem.

S3_impossibility_theorem.statement: On a fixed graph, if the birth band excludes 1 and the passive set is independent at every phase, there is no nontrivial activity cycle. Independent of the survival band; the birth side and the degree-zero convention suffice.

project_prior_art.note: RECORDED BY THIS PROJECT BEFORE THE REPORT. This is CHECKPOINT_046's Lemma and Theorem, statement and proof: 'A(t) is a vertex cover' is 'P_t is independent', and for a contiguous band 'excludes 1' is hi < 1.
project_prior_art.MS-C-509: upgraded to an iff: a fixed graph carries a moving Boolean layer iff hi = 1

S3_impossibility_theorem.new_content: Only the survival-band independence is new. CHECKPOINT_046 states the node rule as a SINGLE band and PILOT_001's protocol scopes birth != survival out explicitly, so the theorem stood verified on the DIAGONAL of the 92x92 band-pair space.

S4_float_safety_condition.statement: |b - q| > |fl(q) - q| + halfULP(fl(b)), with q = k/d, is a sufficient condition for the binary64 band decision to agree with the exact rational one. Sufficient, not necessary; no certificate at equality.
S4_float_safety_condition.reproduction_note: The probe COUNT is construction-dependent and is not expected to reproduce; what must reproduce is that the proved rule issues zero false certificates and the naive rule issues some.

S5_influence_vs_additivity.statement: Over all 512 subsets of the 9 cross edges between two U0 triangles, one-step zero cross influence implies additivity, but the converse fails: connected graphs with nonzero cross influence can still carry 3*3 = 9 shared live fixed points. Additivity appears in some connected graphs as a numerical/combinatorial equality.
S5_influence_vs_additivity.reviewer_conclusion: One-step full block decomposition is a SUFFICIENT structural certificate for additivity; local Jacobian, finite-step Jacobian and absence of cross influence are not converses.

consequence_of_failure: A CONTESTED claim blocks citation of that claim anywhere in docs/ until it is resolved in docs/OPEN_OBLIGATIONS.md with both measurements recorded. A tool that cannot verify this file's seal must refuse to run rather than proceed against an unsealed statement.
